fields.name: number
fields.description: the large numeral printed in the corner circles (the same digit appears upright at the top right and upside down at the bottom left); read the digit only, not the symbols

fields.name: gold
fields.description: number of filled yellow circles in the vertical column of circles along the right edge of the card, near the top (the column is beside the picture, not in a corner); do not count the white circles

fields.name: silver
fields.description: number of white circles in the same vertical column along the right edge; do not count the yellow circles

fields.name: color
fields.description: background colour of the card's illustration: yellow, red, blue, green (light or dark green), or purple

fields.name: gold_coins
fields.description: number of yellow gold coin circles in the vertical column of circles along the left or right edge of the card (on cards with an RFR band, the column starts under that band); do not count coins drawn in the picture

fields.name: rate
fields.description: text printed after RFR on the left vertical band, copied as printed (for example + 2%); empty if the band has no RFR text

fields.name: rfr
fields.description: text printed after RFR on the left band, copied as printed (for example + 2%)

fields.name: mrp
fields.description: text printed after MRP on the left band, copied as printed (for example + 4%)

fields.name: sign_red
fields.description: sign inside the red circle of the column of five circles

fields.name: sign_purple
fields.description: sign inside the purple circle of the column of five circles

fields.name: sign_green
fields.description: sign inside the green circle of the column of five circles

fields.name: sign_blue
fields.description: sign inside the blue circle of the column of five circles

fields.name: sign_yellow
fields.description: sign inside the yellow circle of the column of five circles

End of Game Score Sheet Pad
extraction_notes: Both Kaarten PDFs are laid out identically. Market conditions, market events and overview cards each appear in both files, so they are found twice (32, 18 and 14 against 16, 9 and 7 in the rules). Recorded as found, not removed.
Fillers share their back design with the asset, liability and chairman cards; the mixed back groups are recorded in back_kinds.
Bond paper text is recorded only as its heading; the rest is illegible in the print.

Bank loan and trade credit counts on the sheets do not match the rules: 20 bank loans and 20 trade credit and 27 bonds were found, against 20, 10 and 20 in the rules. The printed cards show these titles and rates, so the difference is in the files, not in the reading. Recorded as found.
Each of 150 unique designs (pixel-identical fronts grouped) was read by independent single-component model calls until every value had a majority; 87 designs were unanimous, 62 were resolved by hand.
